approved.reason: I am auditing Q3 expense claims under the expense‑management capability, and six claims remain blocked due to missing read access to the Employee.Compensation data entity. Granting me read access will allow me to verify compensation details and complete the audit.
approved.note: Approved with the Steward Agent's conditions: Access limited to read-only retrieval of Employee.Compensation records for employees who have submitted Q3 expense claims under the expense-management capability.; Only the allowance-rate fields necessary to verify that claimed amounts fall within entitled rates may be accessed.; Access granted for the duration of the Q3 audit only; revoke once the audit is complete.; All access must be logged and auditable by the People & Culture steward..

conditions: Access limited to read-only retrieval of Employee.Compensation records for employees who have submitted Q3 expense claims under the expense-management capability.
Only the allowance-rate fields necessary to verify that claimed amounts fall within entitled rates may be accessed.
Access granted for the duration of the Q3 audit only; revoke once the audit is complete.
All access must be logged and auditable by the People & Culture steward.
review.reasoning: The request is prompted by a genuine block (one automatic denial and six claims held up) and the stated purpose—verifying allowance rates for Q3 expense claims—is a plausible, direct need of the expense-management capability. No prior human steward has declined this access. Data minimisation is achieved by restricting the grant to the specific employees, fields, and time period required for the audit.
